accordion.title: Who are you and what is your focus?
accordion.content: I am TranTu, a Fullstack Developer. I am deeply passionate about building and developing modern web applications.

accordion.title: What is your role in a project?
accordion.content: I enjoy being involved in the entire development process. My work ranges from crafting responsive user interfaces to building backend systems, designing RESTful APIs, and managing databases.

accordion.title: What is your current tech stack?
accordion.content: I am continuously learning to optimize my work. Currently, I am focusing on advancing my skills in React, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and WordPress.

items.role: Software Engineering Student @ Duy Tan University
items.desc: Started my programming journey, building a strong foundation in logical thinking, computer science, and software development methodologies.
Developed and implemented high-quality commercial templates for ThemeForest. Specialized in pixel-perfect UI implementation and responsive design using HTML, CSS, and jQuery.

Built complex enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, CMS) and WordPress projects. Focused on crafting reusable React components, integrating RESTful APIs, managing databases, and collaborating via Git/GitLab workflow.
